name: Gale Reef
description:
Gale Reef - Explore vibrant coral formations and crystal-clear waters along our premier diving reef location.

Ideal for both beginner and experienced divers looking for an unforgettable underwater getaway.

name: Dawson's Reef
description:
Dawson's Reef - Discover abundant marine life, sea turtles, and shallow reef shelves teeming with tropical fish.

Includes guided reef excursions and full equipment rentals right from the resort Marina.

name: Claire's Reef
description:
Claire's Reef - Experience deep-water coral walls and calm turquoise lagoons along our scenic southern reef.

Enjoy full-day boat charters, reef photography tours, and sunset beachside dining.
